_doc: Big moments as 4-part sequences (one day, four popups): 1) THEIR move — by the partner's temperament (NF idealist / NT rational / SJ guardian / SP artisan); 2) YOUR inner moment — by your temperament, choices filtered by your own letters (E/I, F/T, J/P); 3) the moment right before — by both J/P (plan: both J, free: both P, mixed); 4) the climax (the arc step itself). Each choice's `fits` letters are what the partner responds to: matching their MBTI gives `r` and adds spark; clashing gives `rMiss`. Spark bends the climax toward `good`. {them} = the partner / destined person. `titles`: one poetic title per part (no '(1/4)'); the last is the climax's.

line.ko: ({them}이(가) 밤 산책을 하자고 했다. 가로등 아래에서 하늘을 보며 말했다.) 별 보면 무슨 생각 나? 나는… 요즘 자꾸 한 사람 생각이 나.
line.en: ({them} asked to take a night walk. Under a streetlight, looking up:) What do you think about when you see stars? Me… lately I keep thinking about one person.

t.ko: 나도. 요즘 별 보면 한 사람이 생각나
t.en: Me too. Lately the stars remind me of someone.

r.ko: {them}의 걸음이 아주 잠깐 멈췄다. 둘 다 아무 말도 안 했는데, 다 들린 것 같았다.
r.en: {them}'s steps stopped for a heartbeat. Neither of you said a word, but you heard everything.

rMiss.en: {them} laughed, startled. Too fast?

t.en: Who? (with a teasing smile)

r.en: {them} didn't answer. They just looked at you for a long time.

rMiss.ko: {them}이(가) '…아니야' 하고 웃어넘겼다. 타이밍을 놓친 것 같다.
rMiss.en: '…Never mind,' {them} laughed it off. Maybe you missed the moment.

t.ko: 별자리 앱 켜 볼까? 저게 무슨 별인지 궁금해
t.en: Want me to open a star app? I wonder which one that is.

r.ko: 둘이 머리를 맞대고 화면을 봤다. 어깨가 닿았다.
r.en: Heads together over the screen. Your shoulders touched.

rMiss.en: {them} laughed, but looked a little let down.

line.ko: ({them}이(가) 커피를 내려놓고 진지하게 말했다.) 하나 분석해 봤는데. 우리 3주 동안 하루도 안 빠지고 연락했더라. 이거 무슨 의미라고 생각해?
line.en: ({them} sets the coffee down, serious:) I ran an analysis. We've talked every single day for three weeks. What do you think that means?

t.en: Statistically significant, I'd say.

r.en: {them} burst out laughing. 'See, this is why I like talking to you.'

rMiss.ko: {them}이(가) 웃긴 했는데, 어딘가 대답을 기다리는 눈치였다.
rMiss.en: {them} smiled, but seemed to be waiting for something else.

t.en: What do you want it to mean?

r.en: {them}'s ears went red. The analysis stopped there.

rMiss.ko: {them}이(가) 말을 돌렸다. 질문이 너무 정면이었나 보다.
rMiss.en: {them} changed the subject. Too direct, maybe.

t.ko: 의미 같은 거 따지지 말고, 그냥 좋은 거지
t.en: Don't overthink it. It's just nice.

r.en: {them} fiddled with the cup, then said softly, '…Yeah. It's nice.'

rMiss.en: 'Overthinking is kind of my thing.' {them} looked a little sheepish.

line.ko: ({them}이(가) 내가 지나가듯 말한 가게를 기억하고 예약까지 해 뒀다.) 저번에 여기 가 보고 싶다고 했잖아. 7시로 해 놨어.
line.en: ({them} remembered the place you mentioned in passing, and booked it.) You said you wanted to try this place. I got us a table at seven.

t.en: You remembered that? (touched)

r.ko: {them}이(가) 쑥스러운 듯 웃었다. '네가 한 말은 다 기억해.'
r.en: {them} smiled, embarrassed. 'I remember everything you say.'

rMiss.ko: {them}이(가) 웃긴 했는데, 어딘가 대답을 기다리는 눈치였다.
rMiss.en: {them} smiled, but seemed to be waiting for something else.

t.en: Next time's on me. Let's take turns.

r.en: At the words 'next time,' {them}'s face lit up.

rMiss.en: {them} nodded. Too businesslike?

t.en: (Show up early and wait)

r.ko: {them}도 일찍 와 있었다. 둘 다 20분 먼저 와서, 둘 다 웃었다.
r.en: {them} was early too. Both twenty minutes early, both laughing.

rMiss.ko: 혼자 20분을 기다렸다. 그래도 문이 열리는 순간 다 괜찮아졌다.
rMiss.en: You waited twenty minutes alone. The moment the door opened, it was fine.

line.ko: ({them}이(가) 퇴근길에 전화를 걸었다.) 야, 지금 나와. 강변에서 불꽃놀이 한대. 10분 안에!
line.en: ({them} calls on your way home:) Hey, come out right now. Fireworks by the river. Ten minutes!

t.en: (Throw on shoes and run)

r.ko: 숨이 턱까지 찼을 때 첫 불꽃이 터졌다. {them}이(가) 내 손을 잡고 하늘을 가리켰다.
r.en: You were out of breath when the first firework burst. {them} grabbed your hand and pointed up.

rMiss.ko: 늦게 도착해서 마지막 불꽃만 봤다. 그래도 {them}은(는) 웃고 있었다.
rMiss.en: You arrived late, just for the last one. {them} was smiling anyway.

t.en: I'm in pajamas… but I'm coming.

r.ko: 잠옷 바람으로 나타난 나를 보고 {them}이(가) 배를 잡고 웃었다. 오늘 밤의 하이라이트였다.
r.en: {them} doubled over laughing at you in pajamas. Highlight of the night.

rMiss.ko: {them}이(가) 웃었지만, 사람들 시선에 내가 더 신경 쓰였다.
rMiss.en: {them} laughed, but you were too aware of people staring.

t.ko: 다음엔 미리 말해 줘. 오늘은 못 가
t.en: Tell me earlier next time. Not tonight.

r.ko: '오케이, 다음엔 일주일 전에 말할게.' {them}이(가) 진지하게 약속했다. 귀여웠다.
r.en: 'Okay, next time I'll tell you a week ahead,' {them} promised, very seriously. Cute.

rMiss.ko: '아… 그래.' 전화 너머 목소리가 조금 작아졌다.
rMiss.en: 'Oh… okay.' The voice on the phone got a little smaller.

NF.ko: (집에 와서도 심장이 진정이 안 된다. 일기장을 폈다. '오늘, 확실해졌다.')
NF.en: (Home, your heart still won't settle. You open your journal: 'Today, I knew for sure.')

NT.ko: (머릿속으로 시뮬레이션을 돌려 본다. 고백 성공 확률… 계산이 자꾸 틀린다. {them} 얼굴이 자꾸 끼어든다.)
NT.en: (You run simulations in your head. Odds a confession works… the math keeps breaking. {them}'s face keeps getting in the way.)

SJ.ko: (달력을 봤다. 알고 지낸 지 딱 100일째 되는 날이 다음 주다. 그날이 맞는 것 같다.)
SJ.en: (You check the calendar. Next week marks exactly 100 days. That feels like the right day.)

SP.ko: (생각할 시간 따위 필요 없다. 지금 이 기분이면 충분하다.)
SP.en: (No need to think it over. This feeling is enough.)

t.en: Call a friend and spill everything

r.en: 'That's a green light,' your friend insists.

t.en: (Sort out your feelings alone, with music)

r.ko: 같은 노래를 열 번 들었다. 결론은 하나였다.
r.en: Ten plays of the same song. One conclusion.

t.ko: 하고 싶은 말을 편지로 써 본다
t.en: Write what you want to say in a letter

r.ko: 세 장을 쓰고 두 장을 찢었다. 남은 한 장은 진심이었다.
r.en: Three pages written, two torn up. The last one was honest.

t.ko: 고백할 말을 딱 한 문장으로 정리한다
t.en: Boil the confession down to one sentence

r.ko: '너랑 있으면 내가 더 나은 사람이 돼.' 이걸로 정했다.
r.en: 'I'm a better person when I'm with you.' That's the line.

t.ko: 장소, 시간, 할 말까지 계획을 세운다
t.en: Plan the place, the time, the words

r.en: The plan was perfect. Real life never is.

t.ko: (계획은 무슨. 내일 보면 바로 말할 거다)
t.en: (Plans? No. You'll just say it tomorrow)

r.en: Strangely, you felt calm.

line.ko: (약속 장소. 그런데 {them}도 뭔가 준비해 온 눈치다. 둘 다 같은 날을 고른 것 같다.)
line.en: (The meeting spot. {them} seems to have prepared something too. You both picked the same day.)

t.en: Can I say something first?

r.en: {them} held their breath. '…Okay. Go ahead.'

rMiss.ko: '아니, 내가 먼저!' 둘이 동시에 말해서 웃음이 터졌다.
rMiss.en: 'No, me first!' You both spoke at once and cracked up.

t.en: (Wait for them to bring it up)

r.ko: 침묵이 길어졌다. 그런데 이상하게 편안한 침묵이었다.
r.en: The silence stretched. A strangely comfortable one.

rMiss.ko: 침묵이 길어졌다. 둘 다 먼저 말할 용기가 없었다.
rMiss.en: The silence stretched. Neither of you was brave enough.

t.en: We're… thinking the same thing, right?

r.en: {them} slowly nodded.

rMiss.en: 'What thing?' {them} asked back. Do they really not know?

line.ko: (아무 계획 없이 걷다가 비가 쏟아졌다. {f:store} 처마 밑, 둘이 나란히 섰다.)
line.en: (Walking with no plan, rain pours down. Under a {f:store} awning, side by side.)

t.ko: 우산 하나 살까, 아니면… 그냥 여기 있을까?
t.en: Buy an umbrella, or… just stay here a while?

r.en: 'Let's stay.' {them} stepped a little closer.

rMiss.ko: {them}이(가) 웃긴 했는데, 어딘가 대답을 기다리는 눈치였다.
rMiss.en: {them} smiled, but seemed to be waiting for something else.

t.en: (Brush the rain from their hair)

r.en: {them} didn't move. Only the rain was loud.

rMiss.ko: {them}이(가) 깜짝 놀라 한 발 물러났다. 너무 갑작스러웠나.
rMiss.en: {them} flinched back. Too sudden?

t.ko: 비 오는 날 고백하면 평생 안 잊겠지?
t.en: A confession on a rainy day. You'd never forget it, right?

r.en: {them} looked at you. '…Is that a trailer for something?'

rMiss.en: {them} laughed. It sounded like a joke to them.

line.ko: (계획대로 되는 게 하나도 없는 날이었다. 예약은 꼬였고, 결국 둘이 {f:stall}에 앉았다.)
line.en: (Nothing went to plan. The reservation fell through, and you ended up at {f:stall}.)

t.en: (Burst out laughing) This isn't bad, actually.

r.ko: {them}도 따라 웃었다. 오늘 하루 중 제일 좋은 순간이었다.
r.en: {them} laughed too. The best moment of the day.

rMiss.ko: {them}이(가) 웃긴 했는데, 어딘가 대답을 기다리는 눈치였다.
rMiss.en: {them} smiled, but seemed to be waiting for something else.

t.en: Next time I'll plan it properly.

r.en: 'So there's a next time with me?' {them} asked.

rMiss.en: {them} shook their head. 'I liked today, though?'

t.en: (Pass them the hot broth and hold their gaze)

r.en: The look was warmer than the broth.

rMiss.ko: {them}이(가) 국물만 후후 불었다. 눈은 못 맞췄다.
rMiss.en: {them} just blew on the broth. Couldn't meet your eyes.

line.ko: ({them}이(가) 달을 가리켰다.) 오늘 달 진짜 예쁘다. …근데 너 보느라 제대로 못 봤어.
line.en: ({them} points at the moon.) The moon's beautiful tonight. …I couldn't really look, though. I was looking at you.

t.en: I didn't see the moon either.

r.en: {them}'s face slowly came closer.

rMiss.en: {them} smiled shyly and looked back at the moon.

t.en: …That was so cheesy. And it kind of worked.

r.en: {them} laughed, then suddenly went quiet.

rMiss.en: 'Cheesy?' {them} deflated a little.

t.en: (Take their hand instead of answering)

r.ko: 깍지를 꼈다. 손이 떨리는 건 둘 다였다.
r.en: Fingers laced. Both your hands were shaking.

rMiss.en: {them} held on, then let go awkwardly.

line.ko: ({them}이(가) 갑자기 물었다.) 첫 키스할 때 고개를 오른쪽으로 기울이는 사람이 3분의 2래. 너는 어느 쪽이야?
line.en: ({them} suddenly asks:) Two-thirds of people tilt their head right for a first kiss. Which way do you go?

t.en: Guess we'll have to test it.

r.ko: {them}이(가) 잠깐 말을 잃었다. 처음 보는 표정이었다.
r.en: {them} was speechless for a second. A look you'd never seen.

rMiss.en: '…Let's save that for future research,' {them} laughed.

t.en: Why did you look that up? (laughing)

r.en: '…In case it was with you,' {them} said quietly.

rMiss.ko: {them}이(가) 웃긴 했는데, 어딘가 대답을 기다리는 눈치였다.
rMiss.en: {them} smiled, but seemed to be waiting for something else.

t.en: (Tilt your head, just slightly, instead of answering)

r.en: Right. {them} too.

rMiss.en: {them} tilted the other way and you both laughed.

line.ko: ({them}이(가) 집 앞까지 데려다주고도 돌아서지 못한다.) 오늘… 너무 좋았어. 다음 주에도, 그 다음 주에도 보고 싶어.
line.en: ({them} walks you home, then can't seem to leave.) Today was… so good. I want to see you next week. And the week after.

t.en: Every week, then. Promise.

r.ko: {them}이(가) 새끼손가락을 내밀었다. 손가락이 걸리고, 거리가 좁혀졌다.
r.en: {them} held out a pinky. Fingers hooked, the distance closed.

rMiss.ko: {them}이(가) 고개를 끄덕였다. 약속은 했는데, 아직 발이 안 떨어진다.
rMiss.en: {them} nodded. Promise made, feet still not moving.

t.en: (Fix their collar against the cold)

r.ko: {them}이(가) 내 손을 잡은 채 놓지 않았다.
r.en: {them} caught your hand and didn't let go.

rMiss.ko: {them}이(가) 웃긴 했는데, 어딘가 대답을 기다리는 눈치였다.
rMiss.en: {them} smiled, but seemed to be waiting for something else.

t.en: How am I supposed to wait a whole week?

r.en: 'Then… don't wait?' {them} stepped closer.

rMiss.en: {them} laughed. 'A week goes by fast.'

line.ko: ({them}이(가) 놀이터 그네에 올라탔다.) 누가 더 높이 가나 내기! 지는 사람이 소원 들어주기!
line.en: ({them} jumps on a playground swing.) Bet I can go higher! Loser grants a wish!

t.en: (Lose on purpose)

r.en: 'My wish is…' {them} hopped off the swing and came closer.

rMiss.en: {them} noticed. 'You lost on purpose!' The moment fizzled.

t.en: (Win for real)

r.ko: 이겼다. 소원을 말하려는데, {them}이(가) 먼저 웃으며 다가왔다.
r.en: You won. Before you could make your wish, {them} came closer, smiling.

rMiss.ko: {them}이(가) 승부욕에 불타서 세 판을 더 했다. 숨만 찼다.
rMiss.en: {them} demanded three rematches. You just got winded.

t.en: (Stop swinging and just look at them)

r.en: {them}'s swing slowly stopped too.

rMiss.ko: '왜? 벌써 지친 거야?' {them}이(가) 더 높이 올라갔다.
rMiss.en: 'What, tired already?' {them} swung higher.

NF.ko: (이 순간을 평생 기억할 것 같다는 예감이 들었다. 바람 냄새까지.)
NF.en: (You have a feeling you'll remember this forever. Even the smell of the wind.)

NT.ko: (심박수가 확실히 평소의 1.5배다. 원인은 명확하다. 바로 앞에 있다.)
NT.en: (Heart rate: definitely 1.5× normal. The cause is obvious. It's standing right in front of you.)

SJ.ko: (립밤을 발랐던가? 아까 먹은 {f:street} 냄새는? 머릿속 체크리스트가 바쁘게 돌아간다.)
SJ.en: (Lip balm: did you put some on? The {f:street} earlier? The checklist in your head is running fast.)

SP.ko: (생각은 필요 없다. 지금 이 거리, 이 공기면 충분하다.)
SP.en: (No thinking needed. This distance, this air. It's enough.)

t.en: Crack a joke to break the tension

r.ko: {them}이(가) 웃었다. 웃음 끝에 둘 다 조용해졌다.
r.en: {them} laughed. Then you both went quiet.

t.en: (Quietly steady your breath)

r.en: Close enough to hear each other breathe.

t.en: (Hold their gaze for a long time)

r.en: {them} closed their eyes first.

t.en: (Close the distance, casually)

r.en: {them} didn't step back.

t.en: (Count it out. On three…)

r.en: One, two…

t.en: (Just follow your heart)

r.en: Your body moved before your mind did.

line.ko: (가로등이 깜빡였다. 둘 다 '지금이다'를 기다리는 것 같다.)
line.en: (The streetlight flickers. You're both waiting for 'now.')

t.en: …Can I, now?

r.en: {them} answered by closing their eyes.

rMiss.ko: '…응.' 대답이 너무 작아서 다시 물어볼 뻔했다.
rMiss.en: '…Yes.' So quiet you almost asked again.

t.en: (Wait for the streetlight to go out)

r.en: The light went out. Right then. Really.

rMiss.ko: 가로등은 끝내 꺼지지 않았다. 둘 다 웃었다.
rMiss.en: The light never went out. You both laughed.

t.en: (Reach for their hand first)

r.ko: 손을 잡은 채, 아주 천천히 가까워졌다.
r.en: Holding hands, you drew closer, very slowly.

rMiss.ko: {them}이(가) 웃긴 했는데, 어딘가 대답을 기다리는 눈치였다.
rMiss.en: {them} smiled, but seemed to be waiting for something else.

line.ko: (갑자기 비가 내렸다. 둘 다 피할 생각이 없다.)
line.en: (It suddenly starts to rain. Neither of you moves to get out of it.)

t.en: (Laugh in the rain)

r.ko: {them}도 웃었다. 젖은 앞머리 사이로 눈이 마주쳤다.
r.en: {them} laughed too. Eyes met through wet bangs.

rMiss.ko: {them}이(가) 웃긴 했는데, 어딘가 대답을 기다리는 눈치였다.
rMiss.en: {them} smiled, but seemed to be waiting for something else.

t.en: (Hold your coat over both your heads)

r.en: Under the coat, the world got very small.

rMiss.en: 'I'm fine,' {them} said, pushing the coat away.

t.en: Like a movie, right?

r.en: 'Then the next scene is…' {them} whispered.

rMiss.en: 'We'll catch a cold.' {them} was practical.

line.ko: (엘리베이터 문이 닫히기 직전이었다.)
line.en: (The elevator doors were about to close.)

t.en: (Hit the door-open button)

r.ko: 문이 다시 열렸다. {them}이(가) 그 자리에 서 있었다.
r.en: The doors slid open. {them} was still standing there.

rMiss.ko: {them}이(가) 웃긴 했는데, 어딘가 대답을 기다리는 눈치였다.
rMiss.en: {them} smiled, but seemed to be waiting for something else.

t.en: (Let the doors close)

r.en: Just before they shut, {them} slipped inside.

rMiss.en: The doors closed. Floor one, two… your phone buzzed: 'Come back down.'

t.en: (Wave goodbye, then turn back)

r.en: You turned back. So had {them}.

rMiss.en: {them} was already walking away. You called their name.

line.ko: ({them}이(가) 우리 첫 데이트 장소에 다시 가자고 했다. 같은 자리, 같은 메뉴.) 기억나? 여기서 네가 처음 웃었어.
line.en: ({them} wants to go back to your first-date spot. Same table, same menu.) Remember? This is where you first laughed.

t.en: I remember all of it. Every detail.
